environment.description: Same Quarkus native image deployed behind an Istio ingress gateway (envoy-based) in a GKE Autopilot cluster. The ingress gateway's Gateway resource specifies a credentialName referencing a Kubernetes secret containing a CA bundle (internal PKI root 'acme-services-ca'). The gateway's TLS mode is set to MUTUAL (not SIMPLE), meaning the envoy listener requires a valid client certificate signed by acme-services-ca before completing the TLS handshake and forwarding to the upstream Pod. The PeerAuthentication policy for the workload namespace is set to STRICT mode. Additionally, the Sidecar resource limits egress to only the report-storage service. The /tmp in the container is backed by an emptyDir with medium: Memory and sizeLimit: 10Mi, mounted read-only at the Pod securityContext level via a projected volume override (the Quarkus app writes to an in-memory tmpfs at /tmp/reports that is isolated per Pod instance with no shared filesystem). Network policy restricts ingress to only the istio-ingressgateway pods on port 8443.
